Om Namo Venkatesaya
 
The Online Quota of General Srivari Seva for Tirumala and Tirupati, Navaneeta Seva, Parakamani Seva for the month of september- 2026 will be released at 11 AM on 27.7.2026.
 
**Reporting Days:**
 
General Sevaks have to report on the same day of their Seva booking date for both Tirupati and Tirumala.
 
**Note:** The slot from 08-09-2026 to 13-09-2026 is for SIX days only.
 
Brahmostavams slots for Tirumala will be in TWO spells which will be released at 10 AM on July 27.
 
Each spell will be for 10 days.
September 14 to 23 & September 15 to 24.
 
Age limit for Brahmostavams slots- 18 to 50 only.
 
Parakamani Sevaks have to report one day before  their seva booking date  in Tirumala between 2 pm and 4 pm.
 
**Note:**
 
Profile creation is also available for Sevaks.
**Note:**
 
Parakamani sevaks who book september 18 th 3 days slot are allowed for Darshan only on September 20th due to Garuda Seva on 19.9.2026.
 
Kindly cooperate.

Om Namo Venkatesaya
 
The Online Quota of General Srivari Seva for Local SV Temples of
Hyderabad,
Bhuvaneswar,
Visakhapatnam,
Bengaluru and
Vontimitta for september 2026 will be released at 12 NOON on 27.07.2026.
 
**Note:**
 
Only LOCALS of the above temples have to apply.
 
NO Accommodation/Transport will be provided by TTD.
 
**Reporting Days:**
 
General Srivari Sevaks have to report on the same day of their Seva booking date in the respected temple premises to concern reporting in-charges.

Om Namo Venkatesaya
 
The second spell of 7-day Train the Trainers programme will be in July and August 2026.
 
The Sevaks aged between 45years to 65years with a minimum qualification of Degree are eligible to book as TRAINER.
 
The Trainers quota for each batch is 200 which will be released online on 27.5.2026 at 11AM for 10 batches.
 
The details of Batches as follows :
 
For Telugu States(AP & TS)
 
Batch 01: July 01-07

Batch 02:July 05-11

Batch 03:July 09-15

Batch 04:July 13-19

Batch 05:July 17-23

Batch 06:July 21-27

Batch 07:July 25-31
 
For Tamilnadu:
 
Batch 08:July 29-August 04
 
For Katnataka:
 
August 02-08
 
For Maharastra and other Hindi speaking States
 
August 06-12
 
The registered TRAINERS have to report in Seva Sadan-2, located opposite Varaha Swamy Rest House, Tirumala on their prescribed date only with Booking Receipt, Original Adhaar and Relevant Qualification Certificates.
